### CVE-2013-10005 — Infinite loop in github.com/btcsuite/go-socks
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE 400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

The RemoteAddr and LocalAddr methods on the returned net.Conn may call themselves, leading to an infinite loop which will crash the program due to a stack overflow.

Affected:
- github.com/btcsuite/go-socks / github.com/btcsuite/go-socks: affected 0 <0.0.0-20130808000456-233bccbb1abe (semver)
